facts: Belmont Estates is an acreage community in Fulshear, Texas, that promises a different breed of living with beautiful custom homes and space to roam.
The 227-acre Belmont Estates will be home to just 75 residences on 2-acre estate lots with shared lakes, and the bijou setting will make it easy to know your neighbors.
Nestled in Fulshear, the community offers expansive 2-acre estate lots with shared lakes for just 75 families across 227 acres, designed for those seeking space, luxury and the freedom to roam.
The Belmont Estates materials said new homes were slated to begin mid-2025. Visitors should register for the latest timing.
With 2 acres, buyers can design the home of their dreams, and the builders are ready to help. The large homesites can accommodate a spacious single-story home.

The builders were selected for their distinctive design approach and unrivaled quality construction, and will deliver stately residences that create a gracious lifestyle in Belmont Estates. Whether buyers envision a spacious single-story or a stately estate, the builders are known for their quality and creativity.
The builders are William David Homes, Toll Brothers, Partners in Building and Autograph Homes.

The masterplan, updated to the latest site plan, shows Phase 1 homesites assigned to each builder; the remaining homesites are marked Future Development. It is a conceptual rendering, subject to change without notice.
Belmont Estates is off Bois D’Arc Lane and near Bessie Creek. Down the stretch is FM 1093 and all the conveniences fast-growing Fulshear has to offer: the best of both worlds.
With a 2-acre estate lot, residents can create their own wonderland, with space for a pool, play yard, garden and more.
In the community there are shared lakes, an amenity pond, trails for walking and jogging, and parks and green space to meet neighbors and enjoy Mother Nature’s handiwork.

Belmont Estates is served by Lamar CISD, a progressive, growing school district unafraid to challenge students to explore, learn and grow, pairing rigorous curriculums with an array of extracurricular activities at all levels.
The schools listed for Belmont Estates are Huggins Elementary School, Roberts Middle School, Leaman Junior High School and Fulshear High School.

The developer is Highten Capital. Led by a team of seasoned real estate professionals, Highten Capital launched in 2018 with the idea to build communities rooted in connection to family, neighbors and nature.

Highten Capital spent several years acquiring land throughout Texas for communities that deliver beautiful homes, amenities, wide open spaces and an active calendar of events designed to forge friendships among neighbors.
Pricing and availability are subject to change without notice.
The area attractions map is not to scale.
Belmont Estates is in Fort Bend County, Texas.
HOA assessments, one-time fees and the combined property tax rate have not been announced; they will be posted on the HOA & Tax Rates page.

Approximate drives from the Bois D’Arc Lane entry, from OpenStreetMap road data: Fulshear Farmers Market 4 minutes; Roberts Middle School 5; Dean Leaman Junior High 6; Huggins Elementary 7; Fulshear High School 8; H-E-B on FM 1463 11; LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch 18; Katy Mills and Typhoon Texas 22; Houston Methodist West and the Fort Bend Museum 29; George Ranch Historical Park 41.

Belmont Estates offers 2-acre estate lots with shared lakes within the rear of the lots. The lakes are part of the 2 acres, and homeowners still have plenty of backyard to use: more than 1 to 1½ acres. Most lots back onto a lake.

On the site map, lot lines run onto the lakes and are shown dotted across the water. Trails follow the green corridor through the community, pass south of the amenity pond and run down the east side; there is no trail along the north boundary.
FM 1093 is down the stretch from Belmont Estates, with the I-10 corridor close by. Fulshear and Katy are close by to most attractions.
The developer’s website is hightencapital.com.
voice: Home is where your authentic self lives, a place where you can find joy in things small and large. Unfettered by worries, your thoroughbred spirit soars as you realize the possibilities surrounding you. It’s life to the fullest, today, tomorrow and every day.
faq: What makes Belmont Estates different?
Belmont Estates is an acreage community in Fulshear that promises a different breed of living, with beautiful custom homes and space to roam. Let life run wild.
How large are the homesites?

Every estate lot at Belmont Estates is an expansive 2-acre property. On most lots a shared lake sits within the rear of the lot and is part of the 2 acres, and you’ll still have more than 1 to 1½ acres of backyard to use.
How many homes will Belmont Estates have?
The 227-acre Belmont Estates will be home to just 75 residences on 2-acre estate lots with shared lakes, and the bijou setting will make it easy to know your neighbors.
Is the masterplan final?
No. The masterplan is a conceptual rendering and is subject to change without notice.
Who are the builders at Belmont Estates?
Our family of builders is William David Homes, Toll Brothers, Partners in Building and Autograph Homes.
Can I build a single-story home?
Yes. Want a spacious single-story home? Our large homesites can accommodate. Whether you envision a spacious single-story or a stately estate, our builders are ready to help.
What can I expect from the builders?
Selected for their distinctive design approach and unrivaled quality construction, our family of builders will deliver stately residences that will create a gracious lifestyle in Belmont Estates.
Which builder builds on which homesite?

The masterplan shows Phase 1 homesites assigned to William David Homes, Toll Brothers, Partners in Building and Autograph Homes, with the rest marked Future Development. See them on the interactive site map. The plan is conceptual and subject to change.
What is there to do in the community?
When you want to venture out into the community, you’ll find trails for walking and jogging, and parks and green space to meet your neighbors and enjoy Mother Nature’s handiwork.
What can I do with a 2-acre estate lot?
With your expansive 2-acre estate lot, you can create your own wonderland, with space for a pool, play yard, garden and more.
Where is Belmont Estates?
Belmont Estates is in Fulshear, Texas, off Bois D’Arc Lane and near Bessie Creek. Down the stretch from your peaceful enclave is FM 1093 and all the conveniences fast-growing Fulshear has to offer.
What is nearby?

The Belmont Estates area map includes schools, daycares, medical centers, grocery stores, hardware stores, shopping, entertainment, and museums and parks, from LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch to George Ranch Historical Park.
Which hospitals and clinics are nearby?
The area map includes Houston Methodist West Hospital, Memorial Hermann Katy Hospital and Kelsey-Seybold Clinic.
Where can I shop and run errands?

The area map includes LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch, The Shops at Bella Terra, Katy Mills Mall, Costco and the Fulshear Farmer’s Market, plus H-E-B, Kroger and Walmart Super Center, and Ace Hardware, The Home Depot and Lowe’s Home Improvement.
What is there for families nearby?

Nearby on the area map are Cinemark 19 & XD, Typhoon Texas Waterpark, LaCenterra at Cinco Ranch, the Fort Bend Museum, George Ranch Historical Park, the Katy Heritage Museum and Jones Creek Ranch Park, plus daycares including Kiddie Academy of Fulshear, The Goddard School and Fulshear Early Learning Center.
Which school district serves Belmont Estates?
Belmont Estates is served by Lamar CISD, a progressive, growing school district unafraid to challenge students to explore, learn and grow.
Which schools will students attend?
The schools listed for Belmont Estates are Huggins Elementary School, Roberts Middle School, Leaman Junior High School and Fulshear High School.
Who is developing Belmont Estates?

Highten Capital. Led by a team of seasoned real estate professionals, Highten Capital launched in 2018 with the idea to build communities rooted in connection to family, neighbors and nature. Learn more at hightencapital.com.
How do I learn more or get updates?
Register your interest on this site to stay connected, and we’ll be in touch. We can’t wait to help you build your dream home in this beautiful community!
How much are homesites?
Pricing hasn’t been published on this site. Register your interest to hear more. Pricing and availability are subject to change without notice.
How much is the annual HOA assessment?
The HOA assessment for Belmont Estates hasn’t been announced. It will be posted on the HOA & Tax Rates page once it is finalized.
Is there a capitalization fee?
Any one-time capitalization fee will be listed on the HOA & Tax Rates page once it is finalized.
Are there fees when a home is resold?
Transfer and resale certificate fees, if any, will be listed on the HOA & Tax Rates page once they are finalized.
What is the property tax rate?
The combined property tax rate for Belmont Estates hasn’t been published yet. Belmont Estates is in Fort Bend County and is served by Lamar CISD, and the rate will be posted once it is confirmed.
Is there a MUD?
Whether a Municipal Utility District applies to Belmont Estates will be confirmed on the HOA & Tax Rates page.
Are the amenities open yet?
Belmont Estates is still taking shape. Amenity details will be posted on the Residents page as they are confirmed.
Who do I contact with a question?
The HOA management company and its contact details will be posted on the Residents page as soon as they are confirmed. Until then, register your interest and the team will follow up.
What are the shared lakes?
Belmont Estates has 2-acre estate lots with shared lakes within the rear of the lots. The lakes are part of the 2 acres, so the water comes right to your own lot line.
How much backyard will I have?
Plenty. The lakes sit at the rear of the lots, so you’ll still have more than 1 to 1½ acres to use for a pool, play yard, garden and more.
Do all of the lots back onto a lake?
Most lots are backed to a lake. The site map shows every lake, with the lot lines dotted across the water, so you can see which homesites they reach.
Where do the trails go?
Trails for walking and jogging follow the green corridor through the community, pass south of the amenity pond and run down the east side, past the green space.
